items.title: What's new
items.detail: This window appears once for each new desktop release. Reopen it any time from What's new at the bottom of the sidebar.

items.title: New session lives in the Agents tab
items.detail: Use + New at the end of the Agents tab controls. It still targets the project and host in scope, and /new and its shortcut work as before.

items.title: Sort agents by when they were created
items.detail: The Agents sort control now cycles Activity, Name and Created. Created lists the newest first; agents whose creation time is unknown come last, by name.

items.title: The Front desk editor no longer jumps while you type
items.detail: It starts at one line, grows as lines wrap up to its limit, scrolls inside after that, and shrinks back when you delete. Expand still works when you ask for it.

items.title: The wallpaper follows WalStudio's blur and dim
items.detail: A blur change in WalStudio re-blurs the app's wallpaper; a dim change only darkens it, without re-blurring.

limits: WalStudio blur and dim are verified on a test profile and test wallpaper only, not yet on your own wallpaper.
Surfaces served from a URL on another host still open only on that host.
